purpose: Research-only three-level access grades. NOT read by the app. catalog/map_points/AZ.json stays verified|pending; 'access-verified' here is the source of the proposed middle tier (docs/proposed-access-verified-schema.md). Never merge into the catalog.

levels.verified: managing-agency GIS point for the launch/ramp + current agency page confirming boating access with no closure + Esri z19 imagery shows the ramp at the water + NHD bank; mirrors catalog/map_points/AZ.json
levels.access-verified: official/land-manager source explicitly names boating/launching/put-in at the site; exact water entry not pinned or not confirmed (approximate area)
levels.pending: no official boating-access statement, private/seasonal access, closure or closure uncertainty, or no official coordinate
